Name: The Great Ace Attorney Clothing(Fashion Sence)
Author: Tinora
Description:
目前包含2件饰品，7个发型，4个帽子，25件衬衫。
这是一个正在进行的项目，未来会添加更多角色的服装。

[b]安装：
[/b]需要FS前置，解压后安装在steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods目录下。

[b]使用：
[/b]通过右键点击从皮埃尔处购买的Fashion Sence手镜来使用该mod。

感谢与我一起创作此mod的贴图作者mok!

有任何问题请在POST界面回复或B站私信@清水结月[center]﻿[/center]Currently includes 2 accessories, 7 hairstyles, 4 hats,and 25 shirts.
This is an ongoing project—more character outfits will be added in the future.

[b]Installation:
[/b]Requires the Fashion Sense framework mod.Extract the files and place them in the steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods folder.

[b]Usage:
[/b]Use this mod by right-clicking the Fashion Sense Hand Mirror purchased from Pierre's shop.

Special thanks to mok, the sprite artist who collaborated with me on this mod!
